$comment: Type-check config for CI. Named deno.ci.json, not deno.json, because
Supabase's bundler reads that name at deploy time and this file is about
our checker rather than the runtime. Deno only reads it when asked:
Its only job is to mark this directory as the project root so Deno stops
walking up to the app's package.json. Without it, checking the server
files resolves the whole Expo tree, and any Expo package published in the
last 24 hours trips Deno's dependency-age policy — a red build caused by
a client dependency the functions never import.
No import map: every specifier in these files is already fully qualified
with npm:, jsr:, or https:, which is what the deployed runtime resolves.
